what_this_is: One governed study-intelligence projection. The existing modern question-level QI and the canonical longitudinal family QI, joined through a single adapter and read by topics, roadmap, cohorts, the workbook and the internal study page. Nothing downstream may re-derive a recurrence number.
what_this_is_not: A second recurrence engine. It computes no families of its own and proposes no merges. It reads two governed layers and reports how they relate.
precedence_rule: For MODERN QUESTION IDENTITY the modern layer wins where its evidence is AUTHORED or DETERMINISTIC -- the canonical layer may extend such a relationship backward but may not silently regroup it. Where the modern evidence is INFERRED and the canonical layer has an adjudicated split, the adjudication wins and the inferred cluster is HELD, not deleted. This asymmetry is earned, not assumed: every DETERMINISTIC modern family agrees with the canonical layer, and every disagreement observed lies in the INFERRED band. If that ever stops being true the validator says so.

modern_dispositions.PRESERVED_AS_IS: The record is carried through unchanged and still readable at its original address.
modern_dispositions.MAPPED_INTO_UNIFIED_MODEL: The record is preserved AND joined to a canonical family, which extends it backward without altering what it says.
modern_dispositions.SUPERSEDED_WITH_EXPLICIT_MIGRATION: A governed migration record names the replacement. Never implicit.
modern_dispositions.DUPLICATE_PROJECTION_CONFIRMED: The record restates evidence held elsewhere; it carries no weight of its own but is not deleted.
modern_dispositions.CONFLICT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Modern and canonical layers disagree materially. Held, not resolved.

reconciliation_verdicts.AGREES: Every member the canonical layer knows sits in one shared family, and that family adds no other modern member.
reconciliation_verdicts.MODERN_MORE_SPECIFIC: The modern layer names members the canonical layer has not yet seen. The modern relationship is the finer statement and survives.
reconciliation_verdicts.FAMILY_MORE_SPECIFIC: The canonical family reaches modern members the modern layer missed. It extends, it does not overwrite.
reconciliation_verdicts.LEGITIMATE_WHOLE_VS_LIMB: The split is explained by a governed WHOLE_VS_LIMB_RELATION join. Not a disagreement -- a preserved distinction.
reconciliation_verdicts.LEGITIMATE_MULTI_RELATION: One modern question legitimately participates in more than one family.
reconciliation_verdicts.CONFLICT: The layers place the same modern questions in incompatible families and no governed join explains it.
reconciliation_verdicts.UNMAPPED: No canonical family has seen any member of this modern relationship.

modern_evidence_classes.AUTHORED: A human wrote it into the paper spec (host_recurrence_hint, reused_from). Governed.
modern_evidence_classes.DETERMINISTIC: Identical normalised stems (sixyear EXACT_REPEAT). Reproducible with no threshold and no judgement.
modern_evidence_classes.INFERRED: A similarity clustering (sixyear NEAR_REPEAT). Proposes; it never decided anything.
modern_evidence_classes.SINGLETON: A one-member group. There is no relationship to reconcile.

readiness_states.READY_TO_STUDY_NOW: A solved answer exists and no currentness risk fires against it.
readiness_states.VERIFY_CURRENT_ANSWER: A solved answer exists and a currentness signal fires. Important, not safe.
readiness_states.NEW_ANSWER_REQUIRED: Materially recurrent and MIW holds no solved answer.
readiness_states.MODERNISE_REQUIRED: A solved answer exists but the framework behind it has moved.
readiness_states.CURRENTNESS_HOLD: Currentness cannot be triaged from held evidence, or the family itself is held. High importance, explicitly unsafe.
readiness_states.HISTORICAL_ONLY: Recurred only in the historical band and shows no modern life.
